# Easy Lot Cayman

> Easy Lot sells land in the Cayman Islands with Direct Owner Financing. We own the lots and finance them to the buyer ourselves, so there is no bank, no mortgage application and no loan committee. Down payments start at 5%, monthly payments are fixed, and pre-approval takes about five minutes with four documents.

Easy Lot Cayman is a land seller and direct lender based at 207 Sparky Dr. Suite 6, George Town, Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands. Phone +1 345 936 2660.

## What "Direct Owner Financing" means here

- Easy Lot holds the title to the land and finances the purchase directly to the buyer. There is no third-party lender.
- Down payment: from 5% of the lot price (about $2,000 on a $40,000 lot).
- Monthly payment: fixed for the whole term. Most buyers pay roughly $400–$700 per month depending on lot, deposit and term.
- No early-settlement penalty.
- Title is registered with the Cayman Islands Lands and Survey Department in the buyer's name once the balance is cleared.

## The application

Four documents, and nothing else:

1. Passport
2. Driver's licence or a second photo ID
3. Job letter confirming employer, role and income
4. Recent utility bill as proof of address

Pre-approval is free, takes about five minutes online, is not a credit application, and most applicants receive an answer the same business day. Co-applications are accepted and both incomes count towards the approval.

## The five steps

1. Get pre-approved — learn your price range and monthly payment before choosing a lot.
2. Send the four documents.
3. Choose a lot on the interactive map on the development's page.
4. Sign the agreement, pay the down payment, complete AML/identity verification.
5. Pay the fixed monthly amount for the agreed term, then take registered title.

## Eligibility

The Cayman Islands place no restriction on foreign ownership of land. Overseas buyers can complete the whole process remotely and do not need a local bank account or credit history. There is no annual property tax in the Cayman Islands. Government stamp duty is payable on transfer.

## Developments

- **Elena Estates** — Little Cayman. Low-density residential lots. https://easylot.ky/project/little-cayman/
- **High Rock Estates** — East End, Grand Cayman. Investment land with road access. https://easylot.ky/project/high-rock-estates/
- **Northshore Estates** — Rum Point, Grand Cayman. Near-shore lots on the north side. https://easylot.ky/project/rum-point-land/

Each development page carries a live interactive map showing which lots are still available.
